GRIEVANCE XXVI ◆ MORAL OBLIGATION

He has subjected protections against preventable childhood disease to an erratic revision of scientific advice.

THE RECORD SHOWS

Federal health officials attempted to reduce recommended childhood vaccinations after reshaping the CDC’s advisory panel; a judge temporarily blocked the changes.

Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. replaced vaccine advisers and pursued changes to longstanding recommendations. A March 2026 ruling found substantial problems with the process and temporarily preserved earlier recommendations. Officials have argued the review strengthens parental choice and trust; medical organizations warn that weakened recommendations jeopardize prevention.

A DOCUMENTED SEQUENCE

3 MILESTONES
  1. 2025Secretary Kennedy remade the federal vaccine advisory body and began reconsidering routine childhood immunization guidance.
  2. December 2025The reconstituted panel altered its hepatitis B birth-dose guidance.
  3. March–April 2026A federal judge blocked reductions to the childhood schedule; federal officials then revised advisory-panel rules.

WHAT THE RECORD DOES NOT ESTABLISH

The March court order is an interim judicial action, not a final adjudication of the scientific value of individual vaccines.
